specificationFacts.source_quote: Master Group’s Indus Cloud, Pakistan’s First AI-Ready, Renewable-Powered Enterprise Cloud, today announced the launch of the country’s first Cisco AI GPU Cluster powered by the latest NVIDIA H200 Tensor Core GPUs, making brand-new NVIDIA H200 GPUs available on Pakistani soil for the very first time.

“Artificial Intelligence will define the next era of economic growth, industrial competitiveness, and national innovation. As Master Group, we are building the infrastructure Pakistan needed someone to build. We must build the digital infrastructure necessary to participate in this transformation—not simply consume it. The launch of Pakistan’s first Cisco AI GPU Cluster powered by NVIDIA H200 GPUs is an important milestone towards creating sovereign AI capability and empowering our innovators, enterprises, and public sector with world-class computing resources.” – Shahzad Malik, Managing Director, Master Group of Industries.

supplyFacts.source_quote: Yes — but licensed, not open-weight. Pokee AI serves Isaac through an OpenAI-compatible developer API , and licenses it for deployment inside a VPC, on-premises, or on-device. The launch announcement advertises Day-0 support for vLLM and SGLang, and single-GPU serving starting from an RTX 4090 or equivalent. The research team publishes measurements only from a single B200-class GPU, so treat the consumer-GPU claim as vendor guidance rather than a reported result.

specificationFacts.source_quote: Long-horizon agents accumulate context faster than they resolve tasks. Every tool output, observation, and intermediate reasoning step stays in the window, and the two capabilities that matter — holding that context and staying coherent across it — have so far been available almost exclusively from cloud endpoints. That excludes regulated industries, public-sector institutions, and on-device applications, where the data is not permitted to leave the boundary at all. Pokee AI released Pokee-Isaac 28B , a 28B text-only foundation model with a 10M-token context window, designed to run inside that boundary. The Pokee research team claims 93.3% on RULER at 10M tokens, parity with the strongest cost-optimized cloud baselines on agentic benchmarks, and a serving profile that fits a single GPU.
